from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html')
lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
patterns=[r'kopfDreh',r'pupillenGlow',r'transform-origin',r'--roll',r'kopfRollDatei',r'kopfRollAusgleichDeg',r'head3D\.roll',r'nickenL',r'nickenR',r'parallax',r'auge',r'eye']
rx=re.compile('|'.join(patterns),re.I)
hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if rx.search(l)]
seen=set()
for i in hits:
    a=max(0,i-5); b=min(len(lines),i+6)
    key=(a,b)
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    print(f'--- LINES {a+1}-{b} ---')
    for j in range(a,b): print(f'{j+1:05d}: {lines[j]}')
print('--- STATIC ELEMENT TAGS WITH RELEVANT IDS/CLASSES ---')
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if '<' in l and re.search(r'(kopf|pupill|auge|eye|glow)',l,re.I): print(f'{i+1:05d}: {l}')
PY
echo '--- PARALLAX/ROLL ASSET INVENTORY ---'
find /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*parallax*' -o -iname '*nicken*' -o -path '*/kopf_rgba_parallax/*' \) -print0 | sort -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do stat -c '%s %y %n' "$f"; sha256sum "$f"; done | head -n 500
echo '--- GIT/PROVENANCE HINTS ---'
for d in /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star; do if git -C "$d" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo REPO=$d HEAD=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD); git -C "$d" status --short --untracked-files=all | grep -E 'kopf_rgba_parallax|nicken|buehne.html' || true; fi; done

echo LIVE_POST_SHA256=$POST
test "$POST" = "$GOT"
